rules.notes: Each unhealed Critical Injury adds +10 to later critical rolls, even after its short-term effect ends (EotE p218, AoR p230, FaD p223). A critical needs a hit whose damage beats soak; one critical roll per hit, but each extra trigger of the critical rating adds +10 (EotE p158, p206; AoR p171, p218; FaD p165, p212). Triumph can trigger a critical regardless of rating (EotE p13). Vicious adds 10 x its rating (EotE p157, AoR p171, FaD p164). Lethal Blows adds +10 per rank (EotE p138, AoR p151; no such talent in the FaD core). Hunter adds +10 per rank against animals (EotE p137, FaD p145). Durable lowers the result by 10 per rank, floor 1, the only stated minimum (EotE p135, AoR p146, FaD p142). Disruptor hits always yield at least the Crippled result (EotE p163, AoR p177). GM may add +50 for planetary-scale weapons hitting a person (EotE p224, AoR p236, FaD p230). Exceeding wound threshold incapacitates and inflicts one Critical Injury (EotE p215, AoR p229, FaD p222). Death: tables list 141-150 The End is Nigh and 151+ Dead; AoR p232 and FaD p224 prose say 151+ kills, but EotE p218 prose says 141 or higher. Heroic Fortitude can temporarily ignore critical effects on Brawn/Agility checks (EotE p137, FaD p145).

rows.name: Minor Nick
rows.summary: Victim takes 1 strain.

rows.name: Slowed Down
rows.summary: On its next turn the victim may act only in the final allied Initiative slot.

effect.duration: victim's next turn

rows.name: Sudden Jolt
rows.summary: Victim lets go of anything it is holding.

rows.name: Distracted
rows.summary: Victim gets no free maneuver on its next turn.

effect.duration: victim's next turn

rows.name: Off-Balance
rows.summary: Victim's next skill check gains one Setback die.

effect.duration: victim's next skill check

rows.name: Discouraging Wound
rows.summary: Convert one light side Destiny Point to dark side; for an NPC victim, convert dark to light instead.

rows.name: Stunned
rows.summary: Victim is staggered through the end of its next turn.

effect.duration: until the end of the victim's next turn

rows.name: Stinger
rows.summary: Victim's next check is one difficulty step harder.

effect.duration: victim's next check

rows.name: Bowled Over
rows.summary: Victim falls prone and takes 1 strain.

rows.name: Head Ringer
rows.summary: Intellect- and Cunning-based checks are one step harder for the rest of the encounter.

effect.duration: until the end of the encounter

rows.name: Fearsome Wound
rows.summary: Presence- and Willpower-based checks are one step harder for the rest of the encounter.

effect.duration: until the end of the encounter

rows.name: Agonizing Wound
rows.summary: Brawn- and Agility-based checks are one step harder for the rest of the encounter.

effect.duration: until the end of the encounter

rows.name: Slightly Dazed
rows.summary: Victim stays disoriented for the rest of the encounter.

effect.duration: until the end of the encounter

rows.name: Scattered Senses
rows.summary: Victim discards every Boost die from its skill checks for the rest of the encounter.

effect.duration: until the end of the encounter

rows.name: Hamstrung
rows.summary: Victim has no free maneuver for the rest of the encounter.

effect.duration: until the end of the encounter

rows.name: Overpowered
rows.summary: The attacker may at once make one more free attack on the victim using an identical dice pool.

rows.name: Winded
rows.summary: For the rest of the encounter the victim cannot take strain voluntarily to fuel abilities or buy extra maneuvers.

effect.duration: until the end of the encounter

rows.name: Compromised
rows.summary: All of the victim's skill checks are one step harder for the rest of the encounter.

effect.duration: until the end of the encounter

rows.name: At the Brink
rows.summary: Victim takes 1 strain whenever it performs an action.

rows.name: Crippled
rows.summary: A GM-chosen limb is disabled until healed or replaced; checks needing that limb are one step harder.

effect.duration: until healed or the limb is replaced

rows.name: Maimed
rows.summary: A GM-chosen limb is lost for good. Without a cybernetic, actions needing it are impossible; other actions gain one Setback die.

rows.name: Horrific Injury
rows.summary: Roll d10 to pick a characteristic; it counts as 1 lower until this injury is healed.

effect.duration: until this Critical Injury is healed

rows.name: Temporarily Lame
rows.summary: Until healed, the victim is limited to a single maneuver per turn.

effect.duration: until this Critical Injury is healed

rows.name: Blinded
rows.summary: Victim loses sight. Upgrade difficulty of all checks twice; Perception and Vigilance checks upgrade three times instead.

rows.name: Knocked Senseless
rows.summary: Victim is staggered until the encounter ends.

effect.duration: until the end of the encounter

rows.name: Gruesome Injury
rows.summary: Roll d10 to pick a characteristic; it drops by 1 permanently, never below 1.

rows.name: Bleeding Out
rows.summary: Each round at turn start, victim takes 1 wound and 1 strain. Every 5 wounds over threshold adds another Critical Injury (reroll repeats).

recurring.trigger: start of each of the victim's turns

rows.name: The End is Nigh
rows.summary: Victim dies once the last Initiative slot of the next round has passed.

effect.duration: after the last Initiative slot of the next round

rows.name: Dead
rows.summary: Victim is killed outright.

rules.notes: deathAtOrAbove means the vehicle is destroyed (Vaporized); Breaking Up (145-153) destroys it after a one-round delay. Damage must exceed armor to cause a Critical Hit (EotE p224, p243). Spending the critical rating cost again on one hit adds +10 per extra critical (EotE p238, AoR p250, FaD p244). Each Critical Hit still on the vehicle adds +10, even if its effect has lapsed (EotE p243, AoR p257, FaD p249). Personal-critical talents and qualities such as Vicious do not apply to vehicles (EotE p238, AoR p250, FaD p244). Hull trauma over threshold: silhouette 3 or less unimportant craft simply explode or are disabled; larger or PC-crewed craft take one Critical Hit and go adrift (EotE p242-243). A crippled ship patched back into the fight takes a Critical Hit at +30 whenever it suffers hull trauma (EotE p243, AoR p256, FaD p248). Severity sets the repair difficulty, which the GM may adjust (EotE p243).

rows.name: Mechanical Stress
rows.summary: Vehicle takes 1 system strain.

rows.name: Jostled
rows.summary: Every crew member takes 1 strain and is disoriented for one round.

effect.duration: one round

rows.name: Losing Power to Shields
rows.summary: Defense in the struck zone drops by 1 until repaired; a vehicle without defense takes 1 system strain instead.

effect.duration: until the Critical Hit is repaired

rows.name: Knocked Off Course
rows.summary: Pilot's next turn allows no maneuvers and requires a Piloting check, difficulty set by current speed, to regain control.

effect.duration: pilot's next turn

rows.name: Tailspin
rows.summary: Until the pilot's next turn ends, attacks fired from the vehicle add two Setback dice and all crew are immobilized.

effect.duration: until the end of the pilot's next turn

rows.name: Component Hit
rows.summary: An attacker-chosen component stops working until the end of the next round (see Tables 7-10 and 7-11).

effect.duration: until the end of the following round

rows.name: Shields Failing
rows.summary: Defense in every zone drops by 1 until repaired; a vehicle without defense takes 2 system strain instead.

effect.duration: until the Critical Hit is repaired

rows.name: Navicomputer Failure
rows.summary: No hyperspace jumps until repaired (navicomputer or astromech down); a vehicle lacking a hyperdrive loses its navigation instead.

effect.duration: until the Critical Hit is repaired

rows.name: Power Fluctuations
rows.summary: Until repaired, the pilot may not voluntarily take system strain, for example to buy an extra maneuver.

effect.duration: until the Critical Hit is repaired

rows.name: Shields Down
rows.summary: Struck zone's defense becomes 0 and other zones lose 1 until repaired; defense may still be shifted in. No-defense vehicles take 4 system strain.

effect.duration: until the Critical Hit is repaired

rows.name: Engine Damaged
rows.summary: Top speed falls by 1, not below 1, until repaired.

effect.duration: until the Critical Hit is repaired

rows.name: Shield Overload
rows.summary: All zones' defense becomes 0 and the vehicle takes 2 system strain; no repair before the encounter ends. No-defense vehicles lose 1 armor.

effect.duration: until repaired; repair impossible before the encounter ends

rows.name: Engines Down
rows.summary: Top speed becomes 0 until repaired, though momentum keeps it on course; no maneuvers until repaired.

effect.duration: until the Critical Hit is repaired

rows.name: Major System Failure
rows.summary: An attacker-chosen component is wrecked and stays inoperable until the critical is repaired (see Tables 7-10 and 7-11).

effect.duration: until the Critical Hit is repaired

rows.name: Major Hull Breach
rows.summary: Hull ruptures. Silhouette 4 or less fully depressurizes over rounds equal to silhouette; larger ships lose GM-chosen sections. In atmosphere, apply Destabilized instead.

rows.name: Destabilized
rows.summary: Hull trauma threshold and system strain threshold are both cut to half their original values until repaired.

effect.duration: until repaired

rows.name: Fire!
rows.summary: Vehicle takes 2 system strain at once; anyone in the flames takes fire damage. Extinguishing needs GM-set checks and one round per 2 silhouette.

rows.name: Breaking Up
rows.summary: Vehicle is destroyed at the end of the following round; occupants get one round to bail out or reach escape pods.

effect.duration: destroyed at the end of the following round

rows.name: Vaporized
rows.summary: Vehicle is utterly destroyed with no survivors.

personal.rules: A Medicine check at the injury's severity removes that Critical Injury; each injury allows one such check per week. Treating yourself adds two difficulty; lacking proper medical gear adds one. Droids use Mechanics instead, and a droid repairing itself adds only one difficulty. Natural recovery: after each full week of rest, a Resilience check at the severity removes one injury, Triumph clears one more, and failure still heals 1 wound. In a bacta tank the Resilience check comes every 24 hours. Stimpacks, oil baths and repair patches never remove criticals. An injury stays, still adding +10, until removed.

vehicle.rules: Repairs use the Damage Control ship action (any crew member, not pilot-only): a Mechanics check at the critical's severity, which the GM may modify. Failed repairs may be retried repeatedly until fixed, limited only by one action per character per turn. Shield Overload cannot be repaired before the encounter ends. Until repaired, each Critical Hit counts against the vehicle and adds +10 to later critical rolls.

naturalRest.rules: Every full night's rest heals 1 wound regardless of condition, and a good night's sleep normally clears all strain. After each full week of rest, attempt the Resilience check against one Critical Injury (see healing.personal). Same pages: after an encounter, a Simple Discipline or Cool check recovers 1 strain per success. First aid: one Medicine check per patient per encounter, Easy at or under half wound threshold, Average above half, Hard past threshold; successes heal wounds, Advantage heals strain. Bacta: 1 wound per 2 hours, or per 6 hours while incapacitated. Stimpacks heal 5, then 4, 3, 2, 1 within a day; the sixth does nothing; potency resets after a full night's rest or 24 hours; applying one takes a maneuver while engaged. Droids: oil bath heals 1 wound per hour; repair patches heal 3 each, five per day.
